_metadata.description: The business-health.intent search leaf: one type-faceted corpus over PRD purpose/value-prop/OTs + requirements, federated to search-hub.

requirements.title: One corpus, type facet, uniform embed recipe
requirements.description: internal/aisearch emits one SourceDoc per PRD overview, per OT, and per requirement with a type facet (prd_overview | operational_target | requirement) and scenario + prd_ref metadata, using one uniform embed recipe across the corpus (multi-corpus invariant); identity chunker.

validation.notes: SourceDoc emission + embed-text composition; SSOT guard in recall_test.go covers the tuning contract.

requirements.title: Gold-standard eval green before ACTIVE
requirements.description: A ≥13-query gold-standard eval (capability-dedup phrasings, intent phrasings, gibberish rejections) passes at the SDA leaves' bar (top-1 accuracy thresholds, gibberish ~0) with reranking enabled by hand, before the provider is registered ACTIVE.

requirements.title: Per-provider SearchControl token
requirements.description: handlers/searchcontrol exposes the SearchControlService with a per-provider token (cli-health pattern); a shared token is a mismatch failure.

validation.notes: Gate uses constant-time compare; empty token always denies (shared control-plane contract, mirrored from cli-health).

requirements.title: Cells #34/#22 ownership, pointer-only answers
requirements.description: The provider registration declares answer-space cells #34 (capability map) and #22 (intent), re-homes the product-manager-agent.requirements stub, and answers 'why' questions with PRD anchors only — never synthesized rationale.

validation.notes: search-hub providers list shows business-health.intent ACTIVE and no product-manager-agent.requirements stub; 5 spot-check queries route with correct top-1.

requirements.title: Declared search substrate
requirements.description: The search substrate stays out of measures-health's undeclared-substrate cross-check: the intent index lives in Qdrant (collection business-health-intent, declared in .vrooli/search.json + service.json qdrant dependency) and adds NO scenario SQL tables — the search module's Schema() returns empty by design, so the SQL-scanning substrate detector has nothing undeclared to flag.

validation.notes: Verified 2026-07-02: handlers/search Schema() returns ""; measures-health substrate detection scans scenario SQL only (measures-health/api/internal/validation/substrate.go); the collection is declared in .vrooli/search.json and the qdrant dependency in service.json.
